messages:
anya: Quick sync — planning a small, signal-gated design partner onboarding for the private preview. Want to lock the acceptance criteria and feedback cadence today.
marcos: +1. what's the primary gating signal we want? activation vs retention?
anya: thinking two-stage: initial qualification (use-case relevance + security fit) then a 2-week activation gate: 2 successful API calls/week or 3 feature-driven sessions.
kevin: activation gate sounds right. can we be more specific on what counts as a 'feature-driven session'?
samira: suggest: a session = an end-to-end flow that hits the model, uses streaming, and exercises fallback policy at least once. simple checklist.
anya: ok: checklist for activation session:
- invoked hosted API or dedicated instance
- used streaming or function-calling
- hit fallback at least once (simulate capacity loss)
- submitted at least one eval prompt set
marcos: sets a high bar but ensures signal quality. what's our target acceptance to invite ratio? we don't want 5% and then no feedback.
kevin: propose ~40% acceptance target for qualified leads, then quota to fill cohort of 20 active partners.
samira: agree. also raise compensation and consent: offer $300 platform credit + 1:1 onboarding session. need legal sign-off on data retention / eval prompts.
anya: noted. Legal slack ping after this thread. For consent language I drafted a short blurb we can embed in the invite: 
```
By joining this private preview you consent to temporary retention of usage logs and prompt/eval data for the duration of the preview (60 days) to help us debug and measure model quality. All data will be accessible only to Redwood DP team and deleted afterward unless you opt-in to extended retention.```
kevin: wording looks good. add opt-out checkbox and clear contact.
marcos: operational asks for eng: add a `dp-onboard` tag to incoming customer records, and emit the activation metric `dp.activation.sessions` so Console can surface cohort health.
kevin: will add metric and dashboard tile. can we wire a webhook for weekly pulse surveys?
samira: yes — weekly micro survey (3 Qs) + one longer eval at day14. Survey Qs: 1) Did the model meet expected fidelity? 2) Any regressions vs baseline? 3) Feature blockers for production.
anya: perfect. how do we handle dropouts? want automated rescue: if a partner misses 2 weeks of activity, assign an onboarding engineer to reach out; mark as 'at-risk' in dashboard.
marcos: agree. add auto-email template and a calendar block for 30-min recovery call.
kevin: implementation note: will need a flag to pause billing for credits until activation complete. ops to confirm.
product-bot: poll created: "Preferred cohort size for first preview" — options: 10, 20, 30. results due EOD.
samira: I voted 20. balance between feedback granularity and support load.
anya: decision: cohort = 20. acceptance target = 40% of qualified invites; compensation = $300 credit + 1:1; activation gate = 2 sessions/week or 3 sessions in 2 weeks; retention policy = delete DP data after 60 days unless opted-in.
kevin: I'll create the Console dashboard + webhook, and add `dp-onboard` tagging.
marcos: I'll draft the invite email and the auto-reminder/rescue templates.
product-bot: poll result: 20 (62%), 10 (25%), 30 (13%).
anya: thanks everyone. next steps: legal review on consent blurb (marcos to ping), kevin to spin up metrics and dashboard by Wed, samira to own survey + eval set, marcos to send invites by Thu. I'll follow up with a 15-min sync Fri to close blockers. :thumbsup:
